notes: Retrospective replay of the 2025-05-18 count, not pre-registered.

Units on the map are the 16 voivodeships. The model runs over 128 cells (voivodeship x gmina-size class) plus abroad and ships, which are counted but not drawn. PKW published the count only by voivodeship and by size class, so each cell's counted votes are reconstructed from those two sets of totals (docs/poland.md).

The count is replayed from 28 archived PKW versions (21:07-11:02 CEST by PKW's own version time); the Internet Archive did not keep every version, so gaps of an hour or more occur (runoff: none between 22:00 and 23:11 UTC, nor between 01:07 and 03:13 UTC).

'Counted' is the share of the expected votes counted (electorate counted, from PKW's own voter counts); 'raw' and 'share' are Trzaskowski's share of the Trzaskowski + Nawrocki vote, abroad included. Map prior = the 2020 first round (Trzaskowski vs Duda) by voivodeship.
Official final (PKW, last archived version): Trzaskowski 6,147,797, Nawrocki 5,790,804 (Trzaskowski 51.50% of the two-way vote). Third-ranked Mentzen is not modelled.

Evidence: Retrospective replay, not pre-registered. The settings (configs/pl2025r1_v1.toml) come only from the 2020 runoff counted in a simulated reporting order, not from any 2025 count; the archived 2025 versions were downloaded and decoded before they were frozen.
